text:
vijay: Heads up, canary deploy blocked - CI failing on remote cache auth when downloading toolchain. Bazel failing with 403 from remote cache.
ci-bot: Build #4218 failed on master at step 'bazel build //services/...'. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4218
sara: seeing same locally, started getting 403s around 03:12 UTC, likely cache eviction/role token expiry.
mike: ops - any S3 token rotation events? We rotated cache credentials earlier for rotation schedule but should have rolled.
ops-bot: Noted: Key rotation job completed 02:59 UTC. No failures reported. Related alert: remote-cache-auth-error spike.
laura: I'm checking auth service - IAM role used by bazel cache worker had attached policy updated, might have lost s3:GetObject on the new role.
vijay: If true, we need a hotfix: either restore old role/policy or flip bazel cache to read-only with fallback to fetch-from-source (much slower).
sara: For release schedule: canary is mid-window. Recommend hold canary and promote only after fix + one green canary run.
mike: Ops can revert policy to previous version. ETA 15m.
ops-bot: Reverted policy to previous version (policy-id: p-9f3) at 03:28 UTC. Restarting cache worker.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered: Build #4219 started by @vijay.
ci-bot: Build #4219 step 'bazel build' succeeded -> continuing tests.
laura: smoke tests failing in dockerize step, looks like cached layer pulls succeeded but later integration tests time out. Investigating logs: ```ERROR: failed to start container: network unreachable```
vijay: Could be collateral from cache warm-up. Let's run isolated smoke tests: `bazel test //infra/smoke:all --test_output=errors`
sara: Ran isolated - all smoke tests passed locally. Integration timeouts seem flaky. I'm going to re-run canary pipeline once more.
ci-bot: Build #4220 started.
ci-bot: Build #4220 passed all stages. Canary OK. Holding QA for 30m before promote.
vijay: Decision: hold release promo until EOD change window cleared and add change note: pinned remote-cache policy rollback + follow-up ticket to harden credential rotation. I'll update release notes and open a postmortem if recurring.
sara: Filed ticket INC-7421 with timeline and reproducer.
vijay: Thanks all, promoting to stable at 04:05 UTC unless objections. :thumbsup:
